title: Bloxd.io Blocks
description: This project adds Bloxd.io blocks, such as "the" Mega compressed messy stone and the food blocks. Also adds some advancements.
body:
**[JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) is STRONGLY recommended!!**
All Blocks

Compressed Cobblestone

Extra Compressed Cobblestone

Super Compressed Cobblestone

Hyper Compressed Cobblestone

Ultra Compressed Cobblestone

Mega Compressed Cobblestone

Apple Block

Bread Block

This project adds a bunch of blocks from Bloxd.io into Minecraft, like the Mega Compressed Messy Stone and different food blocks. The Mega Compressed Messy Stone (Cobblestone) is basically the ultimate messy stone (cobblestone) — way past the normal compressed versions, just for people who want something ridiculous and dense to build with, flex on their friends, or just get a stronger block than obsidian. The food blocks are simpler but fun. You can place things like apple blocks or berry blocks around your world, kind of like decorative storage that also gives you food when broken. They fit right in with gardens, markets, or just random colorful builds. On top of that, the project adds actual advancements based on Bloxd.io. You’ll get progress tracking and unlock new goals as you craft these blocks, collect different fruits, or push your way up to the max messy stone (cobblestone) tier. Nothing too complicated — just some extra direction if you’re into that. Overall, it’s just a small mod for anyone who plays both games and wants a bit of Bloxd.io’s weird, blocky charm inside Minecraft. No massive overhauls, just blocks and goals that feel familiar if you’ve played Bloxd before.
